newsitem.title: INDIA: India HCL 96/97 refined copper output 67,867 T.
newsitem.headline: India HCL 96/97 refined copper output 67,867 T.

text.p: India's state-run Hindustan Copper Ltd produced 67,867 tonnes of refined copper in 1996/97 (April-March), up 3.6 percent from the previous year, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Friday.
HCL produced 41,389 tonnes of continous cast copper wire rod in 1996/97, up 11 percent from 1995/96, PTI said.
The company in 1996/97 produced 610 kg of gold, an increase of 27 percent over the previous year and 6,096 kg of silver, up nine percent from 1995/96, the news agency said.
